task:
A gross settlement of 5977 credits is reduced by 12%. The reduced figure includes a 29% fee measured on its fee-free base; remove that included fee by division. Then add 3% of the ORIGINAL gross settlement. What is the exact result? Do not round. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 10 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 23 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 26 credits, then discount the whole amount by 16%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 10% surcharge, then subtract 8 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 20 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 12% surcharge, then subtract 7 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 4%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 16 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 19 credits, then discount the whole amount by 14%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 6% surcharge, then subtract 21 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 16% surcharge, then subtract 26 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 17 credits, then discount the whole amount by 16%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 11 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 25 credits, then discount the whole amount by 7%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
